g01-good-day.observed_description: A man of about thirty-five in a light-blue shirt and khaki trousers walks along a sunny park path between green trees, laughing with his face turned up to the sun, a takeaway coffee cup in one hand. Blue sky. One person.
g01-good-day.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop (he stands in the middle). A plainly good, happy day at 180 px; nothing in the photo is written.

g02-bad-day.observed_description: A soaked woman with wet dark hair in a blue trench coat stands on a rainy gray street holding a black umbrella blown inside out; a dropped paper coffee cup lies spilled on the wet pavement at her feet. She looks down with an unhappy, fed-up face. One person.
g02-bad-day.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop. A plainly bad day at 180 px (rain, broken umbrella, spilled coffee); she is not hurt or ill. Nothing in the photo is written.
